headline: [Interview] What a Former Wall Street IB Sees in RWA: 'Tokenization Is a Means; We Must Open a New Market'
summary: An interview with a former Wall Street investment banker discusses real-world asset tokenization, centred on government bonds and stablecoins. He argues it could extend to non-financial assets and reduce settlement burdens.
why: Tokenization of real-world assets applies blockchain to bonds and other securities, and is being explored by banks and securities firms for faster settlement.
